_comment: English overlay for glossary.json. Empty string = use Korean.

ssb.short: The beacon a base station sends periodically: sync signals and the basic notice in one block.

pss.short: Primary sync signal. Found first; used to align time.

sss.short: Secondary sync signal. Together with the PSS it gives the cell ID.

pbch.short: The channel that carries the basic notice (MIB).

dmrs.short: A reference signal sent alongside so the contents can be read correctly.

pci.short: The number (0–1007) that tells a cell apart from its neighbours.

gscn.short: A number given to each frequency position where an SSB may sit.

ss_ref.short: The centre frequency of the SSB.

arfcn.short: A way of writing a frequency as a number.

scs.short: The spacing between subcarriers: 15 kHz, 30 kHz, …

cfo.short: The frequency difference between receiver and base station. Large for satellites because they move fast (Doppler).

rsrp.short: Received strength of the sync signal.

sinr.short: How much stronger the signal is than noise and interference. Higher reads better.

ssb_index.short: Which one of the several SSBs (beams) sent in a burst this is.

sfn.short: The base station's clock: a frame number (0–1023) that goes up every 10 ms.

half_frame.short: Whether this is the first (0) or second (1) half of the 10 ms frame.

k_ssb.short: How far the SSB is offset from the common resource grid, in subcarriers.

mib.short: The most basic notice. It says where to get SIB1.

coreset0.short: The frequency-time region that carries the control signal pointing to SIB1.

search_space.short: The moments at which the control signal has to be looked for.

pdcch.short: The control channel that says 'the data is over there'.

pdsch.short: The data channel that carries the actual contents (SIB body).

dci.short: Control information on the PDCCH: where the data is and how it is formatted.

si_rnti.short: A shared identifier (0xFFFF) used only for broadcast information.

sib1.short: The access guide: network, cell ID and the schedule of further notices.

sib19.short: A notice only satellite (NTN) base stations broadcast: satellite position and delay corrections.

plmn.short: Network identifier: country code (MCC) plus operator code (MNC).

tac.short: The number of the area group the base station belongs to.

point_a.short: The reference frequency from which resource blocks are numbered.

bwp.short: The frequency range a device actually uses.

prach.short: The channel on which a device sends its first access attempt.

si_window.short: The time span in which one further notice is broadcast.

ntn.short: A network whose base stations are not on the ground, e.g. on satellites.

ta.short: A timing correction so the device transmits early by the travel time.

ta_common.short: The value that compensates the delay between the satellite and the ground gateway.

k_offset.short: A value that postpones scheduling to allow for the long delay to the satellite.

epoch_time.short: The time the satellite position and velocity values refer to.

validity.short: How long this satellite information may be trusted. After that it must be received again.

ecef.short: A coordinate system centred on the Earth and rotating with it.

doppler.short: The apparent frequency change because the satellite approaches or recedes.

elevation.short: The angle from the horizon up to the satellite.

azimuth.short: The direction of the satellite, measured clockwise from north.

sigmf.short: A standard format for storing received signals (IQ) with a description file.

iq.short: The raw numbers an SDR receives.

ra_rnti.short: The number used to find the base station's answer to an access attempt.
